brief:
Youssef Jibarin, head of the Joint List, said Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was repeating false statements to prevent a government transition, the Maan Wire reported. Jibarin stated that the parliamentary majority had decided the matter and called for the current government to be replaced.

He described the sitting administration as an unlawful government responsible for bloodshed that must leave office.
dek: Youssef Jibarin, head of the Joint List, said Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was repeating false statements to prevent a government transition, the Maan Wire reported.
title: Jibarin accuses Netanyahu of blocking government change with false claims
